creator.intro: Build a program from a ready-to-edit starting point. Choose a class, pick an idea, then make it yours.
creator.classHint: Select an existing class or group. Its business type determines the suggestions.
creator.templateTitle: Start with an idea, not a blank form
creator.templateHint: Choose a starting point. You can edit everything next.
creator.customHint: Start from your own title and objectives.
creator.replace: Continuing with a different template replaces your edited title and objectives. Dates are preserved.
creator.reviewHint: Review the content and set when the program runs.
creator.scheduleHint: This creates the program only. Next, choose staff and times in the weekly timetable. No sessions or family notifications are generated here.

templateIntro: Start with an existing class, then choose a suggested program or write your own.
templateDisclaimer: Editable suggestions, not official Algerian curriculum or clinical protocols. Adapt them to the group's age and level.
replaceHint: Replaces the title and objectives below. Dates stay unchanged; no sessions are created.
chooseClassFirst: Choose a class to see relevant suggestions.
programNextStep: After saving, open Weekly timetable to assign staff and schedule sessions. Saved programs can be reused from this list.

sensory.title: Sensory discovery
sensory.objectives: Explore textures, sounds and colours through supervised play. Observe each child's responses and respect their pace.
sensory.activities:
Texture exploration
Sound discovery
Colour sorting

movement.title: Movement & coordination
movement.objectives: Practise balance, coordination and movement through age-appropriate supervised games.
movement.activities:
Balance games
Rhythm and movement
Simple movement course

routines.title: Daily routines & independence
routines.objectives: Support participation in familiar daily routines, with help adapted to each child's needs.
routines.activities:
Welcome routine
Tidying together
Preparing for transitions

stories.title: Language & stories
stories.objectives: Develop listening, vocabulary and oral expression through stories, pictures and conversation.
stories.activities:
Picture-book discussion
Story retelling
Songs and word games

numbers.title: Numbers & shapes
numbers.objectives: Explore counting, sorting and shapes through concrete materials and play.
numbers.activities:
Sorting objects
Counting games
Shape discovery

creative.title: Creative expression
creative.objectives: Explore materials and express ideas through art, music and collaborative projects.
creative.activities:
Drawing and collage
Rhythm workshop
Shared creation

practical.title: Practical life
practical.objectives: Develop concentration, coordination and independence with carefully prepared everyday tasks.
practical.activities:
Pouring and transferring
Caring for materials
Putting work away

arabic.title: Arabic language
arabic.objectives: Choose a grade-appropriate unit and define reading, oral expression and writing objectives.
arabic.activities:
Guided reading
Vocabulary practice
Short writing task

maths.title: Mathematics
maths.objectives: Select a topic for the group's level. Build understanding through worked examples, practice and problem solving.
maths.activities:
Concept exploration
Guided exercises
Problem-solving review

french.title: French language
french.objectives: Adapt vocabulary, listening, speaking and writing objectives to the group's language level.
french.activities:
Listening activity
Guided conversation
Reading and writing practice

english.title: English language
english.objectives: Build vocabulary and communication skills through tasks adapted to the group's language level.
english.activities:
Listening and vocabulary
Pair conversation
Short reading or writing task

science.title: Scientific exploration
science.objectives: Choose a level-appropriate topic. Practise observation, questioning and explaining evidence.
science.activities:
Question and observation
Supervised investigation
Discuss findings

communication.title: Group communication
communication.objectives: Plan non-clinical group activities that encourage expression, listening and participation. Adapt with the responsible professional.
communication.activities:
Turn-taking conversation
Picture-based expression
Shared story

cooperation.title: Cooperation & group life
cooperation.objectives: Practise listening, turn-taking and working towards a shared goal, adapted to the group's needs.
cooperation.activities:
Cooperative game
Shared project
Group reflection

title: Learning
description: Programs per class, planned lessons and assessments, structure by structure.

profileHints.academic: Build your own subject programs and record tests or exams. Grading scales are configurable; these are not official report cards.
profileHints.care: Plan care routines and age-appropriate activities. Follow development with observations, not exam marks.
profileHints.therapy: Plan group sessions here. Use the Sessions module for individual therapeutic plans and confidential clinical notes.
profileHints.activities: Organize workshops and seasonal programs around assigned teams and groups.
profileHints.development: Plan weekly activities and follow each child's progress with developmental observations.

errors.programDates: Every date must fall within the program’s. Shorten the repeat or change the first date.

staffHint: Assign staff on the class page first. Only active members of that class's team appear here.
repeatHint: The complete series saves together. Dates must fit the program; conflicting bookings are rejected. All times are Algeria local time.
scoreHint: Used only for tests and exams. Observations use developmental outcomes instead.
programFirst: Create a class and an active program before scheduling.
publishHint: Only saved results are published. Unsaved pupils are not given a mark. Unpublish before correcting a result.
noStudents: No enrolled learners in this class. Assign them from the class page.
parentHint: Only your children's class plans and published results appear here.
